answered_instructional_examples.population: worked examples inside lesson grammar sections and reading passages (answer visible in source)

candidate_regression_tests.population: restated mistake-pattern fixtures promoted via TP-CURR packets after review

development_fixtures.population: pilot fixtures under curriculum/l1l6/pilot/ derived from lesson claims

genuinely_held_out_evaluation_material.reason: every item in the corpus is answer-visible or keyless; honest held-out material must come from elsewhere

worked_exercises.population: common-mistakes contrast sets (wrong vs corrected forms shown)
worked_exercises.reason: answer-visible; usable as adversarial fixture SOURCE after restatement + review

leakage_rule: an answer-visible exercise is never counted as an independent evaluation
